title: 姚妙获环勃朗峰超级越野赛 100 公里组别女子季军 — 新华体育
claims: Xinhua reports that the 2026 CCC route was adjusted because of thunderstorms, increasing the race from the planned 101 km to 108 km with 6,200 m of gain.
Xinhua reports the women's 2026 CCC podium as Yngvild Kaspersen 12:01:14, Toni McCann 12:06:14 and Yao Miao 12:15:41.
Xinhua reports that five Chinese men finished in the top 30, led by Silang Duoji.

verification.note: Media report; used only for the route-adjustment context and women's podium, not as the primary distance source.

claimVerification.note: Article: 部分路线临时调整，赛程由原计划 101 公里增至 108 公里，累计爬升 6200 米.
Article: 四郎多吉领衔 5 名中国男子选手进入前 30.
